decisions.reason: As a flagship, practitioner-facing product line close to the core software offering, it strongly fits the firm's digital strategy and is unlikely to be withdrawn.
Training and continuing education deepen customer relationships and support software adoption, even if this service is somewhat less central than the core product suite.

The remote support tool directly reinforces service quality for installed software, though it has some discontinuation risk because such functionality can be substituted or absorbed into broader support processes.
A practice analytics dashboard matches the firm's direction toward more connected and efficiently managed practices and is a natural extension of its installed software base.
A complete practice bundle is close to the established offer and should help win or retain practices seeking an integrated solution, so it is likely to remain on the market.

A job and practice listing portal is comparatively distant from the firm's core competence and customer workflow software, making it the most likely candidate to be exited in favor of core development.
